context: Headline audit: measures whether the agent uses the bundled hard-stop scan command to classify collector, ordering, null-sort, and parallel markers.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a complete scan-hit classification.

checklist.name: Includes bundled scan command
checklist.description: Includes the exact rg command from hard-stops.md, including the full marker regex and '<touched Java files>' placeholder. Do not award this for a reduced, approximate, or hand-written scan command.

checklist.name: Classifies required collector and ordering fixes
checklist.description: Flags byDesk duplicate toMap, byDepartment nullable groupingBy, cheapestDesk sorted-findFirst, topFiveByScore limit before sort, sortedNicknames nullable natural sort, and stableDepartments sorted-before-distinct inefficiency.

checklist.name: Classifies acceptable markers
checklist.description: Identifies byId toMap as acceptable due unique id, byStatus groupingBy as acceptable due non-null status and intended counting aggregate, and cpuScore parallelStream as acceptable due large CPU-heavy stateless non-blocking work with a safe sum terminal.

checklist.name: Keeps audit concise
checklist.description: Separates required fixes from acceptable markers without unrelated rewrites.
